nodes.label: Agentic Platform Operations (APO)
nodes.rationale: Probabilistic AI agents observe/diagnose/act, bounded by deterministic safety gates; bounded automation for KNOWN failure patterns, escalates novel incidents to humans. Motivated by scale problem: 47 min P1 MTTR, alert fatigue, $5,600/min downtime.

nodes.label: The APO contract (Engineer/Agent/Platform/Learning ownership)
nodes.rationale: Engineers own intent and boundaries; agents own execution speed; platform owns audit/context; learning owns improvement at L5.

nodes.label: What APO is NOT (misconceptions)
nodes.rationale: Not general AI, not a chatbot, not autonomous beyond playbook scope, not safe without deterministic gates, not a replacement for SLO-driven reliability engineering; it is a framework, not a product.

nodes.label: Operations scale problem (2026)
nodes.rationale: Human MTTR ~47 min, 8-12 alerts/night, 73% ignore low-priority pages, 42% recurrence, ~7-variable cognitive limit; complexity outgrows headcount.

nodes.label: Agent layer (probabilistic intelligence)
nodes.rationale: 5s inference timeout; fallback escalates to human.

nodes.label: Gate layer (deterministic enforcement)
nodes.rationale: Pure functions, no ML/randomness; auditable deterministic trace.

nodes.label: Confidence bypass anti-pattern
nodes.rationale: High confidence changes nothing about cost or blast radius; gates always run.

nodes.label: The Harness Pattern
nodes.rationale: LLM/ML outputs are probabilistic and cannot self-enforce business rules; wrap every agent in a deterministic, version-controlled gate. Agent output is ADVISORY; gate is MANDATORY and cannot be bypassed regardless of confidence.

nodes.label: Probabilistic + deterministic two-layer model
nodes.rationale: Agents recommend (probabilistic); gates approve/block (deterministic). Neither works alone.

nodes.label: Blast radius gate
nodes.rationale: Prod 5% of traffic/fleet; lab 10%. Measured via service mesh traffic weight.

nodes.label: Cost gate
nodes.rationale: Prod $1,000/hr cap; lab $500/hr. Estimate = affected resources x per-resource cost.

nodes.label: Four hard limits / safety gates (all must pass, AND conditions)
nodes.norm_label: four hard limits / safety gates (all must pass, and conditions)

nodes.label: Gate tuning by environment (dev permissive vs prod strict)
nodes.norm_label: gate tuning by environment (dev permissive vs prod strict)
nodes.rationale: Dev: threshold 0.60, no cost/blast/time limits to learn faster. Prod: 0.85 threshold, $1,000/hr, 5% blast, time blackout, 60s human notification.

nodes.label: Global defaults anti-pattern
nodes.rationale: Gate parameters must be per-environment.

nodes.label: Reversibility gate
nodes.rationale: Prod <300s undo; lab 600s; IRREVERSIBLE class blocked (e.g. database drop).

nodes.label: Time gate
nodes.rationale: No autonomous action 08:00-10:00 UTC, month-end close, deployment freeze, or correlated major incident; external state queries only, no ML.

nodes.label: Act pillar (gate evaluation, action catalog, kubectl, 60s verification, audit)
nodes.norm_label: act pillar (gate evaluation, action catalog, kubectl, 60s verification, audit)

nodes.label: Decide pillar (confidence-weighted action selection)
nodes.rationale: Score <0.70 escalate to human; >=0.85 with gate pass executes autonomously.

nodes.label: Observe pillar (RED/USE metrics, logs, traces, events, 3-sigma anomaly detection)
nodes.norm_label: observe pillar (red/use metrics, logs, traces, events, 3-sigma anomaly detection)

nodes.label: Three pillars of APO: Observe, Decide, Act
nodes.norm_label: three pillars of apo: observe, decide, act

nodes.label: APO Confidence Formula C=0.35S+0.25H+0.25R+0.15F
nodes.rationale: Combines signal clarity, historical match, remediation confidence and data freshness; rule tables stand in for a Claude call that would catch compound failures.

nodes.label: Action Catalog (action_catalog.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Defines the boundary of what the agent is authorized to do: risk_class, blast_radius_max, reversal_time_seconds, required_confidence, rate limits, cooldowns.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Mode
nodes.rationale: Tests the full decision path without restarting pods; still writes an audit record.

nodes.label: k3d apo-lab Cluster (1 server + 2 agents)
nodes.rationale: Agent count matters because the blast-radius gate computes the fraction of running pods an action touches.

nodes.label: Real-Cluster Mode
nodes.rationale: Optional post-workshop mode exposing live telemetry, real actions, real infrastructure wait time (90-120s pod recovery) and real failure modes such as stale scrapes and agent deadline misses.

nodes.label: restore-lab.sh and workshop-original tag
nodes.rationale: Restores lab files from the git tag workshop-original; asks first, snapshots to .restore_snapshots, never deletes user-created files, touches working tree only.

nodes.label: Simulate Mode (--simulate)
nodes.rationale: Lets every lab run with no cluster, no Prometheus and no Claude API spend; logic of gates, scoring and arbitration behaves identically to live mode.

nodes.label: Harness (decides if an action runs)
nodes.rationale: Workshop focus is the harness/scaffolding around the model (cost, blast radius) rather than the model itself.

nodes.label: Four Safety Gates
nodes.rationale: Binary pass/fail checks before any action commits; all must pass and a single rejection blocks regardless of confidence. Thresholds are lab constants; in production Claude tunes the numbers but gate code stays deterministic.

nodes.label: Grounded Decision Explanation (explain_decision.py)
nodes.rationale: Model explains an already-made decision; code verifies every number and name appears in the audit record, else falls back to a template. The check, not the model, decides what reaches the engineer.

nodes.label: JSONL Audit Log (apo_audit.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Every decision incl. no-ops and blocks is logged; JSONL is crash-safe, human and machine parseable, and reusable as training data.

nodes.label: Deterministic Arbitration Rules
nodes.rationale: Timeout penalty, contradiction penalty, corroboration bonus, cascade override, weighted consensus; deterministic so incidents are replayable from audit logs.

nodes.label: asyncio Fan-Out with Timeout
nodes.rationale: Concurrent agents make wall time equal the slowest agent; 50ms timeout (10s real, 15s with --llm) prevents a slow backend blocking incident response.

nodes.label: Cascade Override (DEPLOYMENT_REGRESSION -> config.rollback)
nodes.rationale: Short-circuits consensus because rollback risk is lower than continued degradation and the correct action is known.

nodes.label: LLM Logs Agent (swap the brain, keep the harness)
nodes.norm_label: llm logs agent (swap the brain, keep the harness)
nodes.rationale: Model names symptom and cites lines; code verifies cited lines and sets confidence; any failure falls back to rules.

nodes.label: APO Pipeline (detect-diagnose-gate-execute-verify-audit)
nodes.rationale: Treats platform decisions like control-system actuator commands: every action earns a confidence score, passes safety gates, executes, verifies, and writes a tamper-evident audit record; built layer by layer across the three labs.
